name: Lands of Intrigue
title: The Golden South: Lands of Intrigue
description: The Lands of Intrigue comprise the wealthy merchant-kingdoms of Amn, Tethyr, and Calimshan. It is a region where coin is king and shadows hold deep secrets.
wiki: Amn is the powerhouse of trade, Tethyr is a kingdom of noble houses and ancient traditions, and Calimshan is a land of desert magic and genies. Together, they form a region of immense wealth and constant political maneuvering. The influence of these lands reaches far beyond their borders, often affecting the entire continent through their merchant fleets and spies.

metadata.landscape: Fertile valleys, dry deserts, rugged coastlines
